subject: a spiral shell built from ocher triangular tesserae
art_direction: 一枚螺壳由赭金三角石片旋成，蓝灰背景强调自然曲线与硬边拼片的对比。

composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Create a spiral shell built from ocher triangular tesserae. Let the triangles become smaller toward the spiral center while the outer rim uses broader pieces. The opening is a deep blue-gray crescent with no extra decoration. Use soft side light to reveal the shallow stone relief. Keep the whole shell compact on an empty pale slate field, without sand or sea props. Use geometric stone mosaic. Square 1024x1024 avatar; keep the central subject clear, with no text, logo, watermark, or circular border.
